posts.text: IRCTC — Should I Hold for Recovery or Exit Gradually? — I still remember IRCTC being one of the hottest stocks during its IPO days, with everyone talking about the listing gains. Hard to believe how much it has fallen since! Fundamentally, though, IRCTC remains a profitable business with strong cash generation and a near-monopoly in railway ticketing, catering and packaged water. However, recent results show revenue growth hasn’t translated into much profit growth, so margins and future earnings are worth watching.
